notes: First money-free reactive vertical: NewsApp poll observation. This is a Standard 205 evaluator/fixture contract, not Chronica production Reuters. Product observation on this branch remains O0. Reuses CAP6 for when-to-poll conceptually; CAP15 declares watch_news_topic; CAP13 is unused because there is no push. Do not read fixture DB as Chronica truth.

semantic_contract.user_intent: Keep a freshness-aware NewsEvent world state from a credentialed news source without scraping DOM each agent turn.
semantic_contract.preconditions: Tenant-scoped credential_handle; compiled NewsApp observation method.
semantic_contract.product_action: bounded poll → change detect → normalize NewsEvent
semantic_contract.state_transition: external article posted → durable NewsEvent + checkpoint vN→vN+1
semantic_contract.authority_requirement: credential_handle only; no secret in agent context
semantic_contract.tenant_requirement: company-scoped entitlement; no cross-tenant paid reuse
semantic_contract.visibility_access_semantics: premium content stays in tenant entitlement
semantic_contract.idempotency_semantics: same provider event id → one NewsEvent
semantic_contract.concurrency_semantics: out-of-order must not regress checkpoint blindly
semantic_contract.user_observable_outcome: agent query sees new canonical NewsEvent
semantic_contract.no_ai_behavior: LLM must not be kept alive to watch the page; ingest is deterministic
semantic_contract.donor_semantics: generic news/RSS/premium newspaper observation, not a vendor claim
semantic_contract.chronica_allowed_divergences: fixture is synthetic; not Reuters production
semantic_contract.known_unimplemented_facets: real provider evidence; Chronica product NewsApp runtime
